description: Amtrak Bus Routes is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The Amtrak Thruway Bus system operates in conjunction with the three Amtrak (Capitol Corridor, San Joaquin, and Pacific Surfliner) train routes in California. A passenger must travel on a train segment in order to use the feeder bus system. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Clearinghouse, Rail, Amtrak, Bus, Routes, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData, California State Transportation Agency. The bounding box given is -124.2165,32.7231,-115.1596,40.9688. The hub shows 2026-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
